name: qa-analyst
description: Analysis-only task workflow for QA: reads tickets, linked requirements, logs, the database and the code, and writes plain-language documents - the answer, flows, findings, test cases and ready-to-paste ticket notes. No code examples, never changes code.

tests.title: Test cases
tests.description: Write 05-test-cases.md with every analysis: test cases TC-* with requirements, type, priority, preconditions, test data and steps with an expected result on each step. Always written for a test design task.

impact.title: Impact in numbers
impact.description: Write 07-impact.md: how many records, users and partners are affected, counted in the database (a SELECT behind every number), by status, partner and day, with conclusions on size, trend and priority.

decision_table.title: Decision table
decision_table.description: Write 08-decision-table.md: every combination of conditions with the expected result from the requirements and today's result, the status transitions, the gaps in the requirements, with conclusions.

logs.title: Log statistics
logs.description: Write 09-log-stats.md: errors by type and hour, first and last time, share of requests, lined up with deploys and commits, with conclusions. Only when the task has logs.

regression.title: Regression scope
regression.description: Write 10-regression.md: what changed in the code between two releases or commits, which business areas it touches, what to retest in which order, a checklist, with conclusions on the risk.

visual_artifact.title: Visual page (Artifact)
visual_artifact.description: After each analysis, build an interactive page (verdict, flows, timeline, requirements, checklist of test cases) and publish it as a private Artifact on claude.ai. Personal data is masked before publishing.

confluence_page.title: Confluence-style page
confluence_page.description: After each analysis, also write confluence-page.md: a plain overview for BA, PM and the team, ready to paste into Confluence. Nothing is published.
